name: goose-2fa
title: Goose 2FA
description: Two-factor code manager with screenshot and image QR scanning, backups, and an optional shared JSON data source
author: eachann_

commands.name: codes
commands.title: Codes
commands.subtitle: Goose 2FA
commands.description: Search accounts; press Return to copy or paste codes according to preferences

preferences.name: enterAction
preferences.title: Return Action
preferences.description: Choose whether Return copies the code or pastes it into the previous field.

preferences.name: closeAfterCopy
preferences.title: After Copy
preferences.description: Close Raycast and return to the previous app after copying a code.
preferences.label: Close Raycast and return to desktop

preferences.name: dataFile
preferences.title: Data Source File
preferences.description: Choose an existing JSON file. Or create one in a chosen folder from Settings & Data. Select the same iCloud file on both clients to sync. The file contains plaintext 2FA secrets.
